mechanism: Adapalene is a retinoid that increases skin photosensitivity and irritation, while penicillin VK can cause photosensitivity reactions; concurrent use may potentiate phototoxic effects and increase local skin irritation.
action: Counsel patient on rigorous sun protection (SPF 30+), avoid concurrent topical use, and monitor for excessive skin irritation; both agents should be used with caution in combination.
